label: sub_035_mgirl_01
text: Want me to judge just how big or small your\nPokémon are?

label: sub_035_mgirl_02
text: Which Pokémon would you like me to check?

label: sub_035_mgirl_03
text: [VAR 0x0102(0001)], eh? Let’s see here...

label: sub_035_mgirl_04
text: Now THIS is a BIG Pokémon! Wow, you almost\nnever see one this huge!

label: sub_035_mgirl_05
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This might just be the world’s biggest\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]!

label: sub_035_mgirl_06
text: This is a serious big’un! Feels comforting to have\nsuch a bulky, reliable buddy around, doesn’t it?

label: sub_035_mgirl_07
text: This one seems a good sight bigger than average!\nIt’s quite a specimen—take good care of it!

label: sub_035_mgirl_08
text: This one seems a little bit bigger than average!

label: sub_035_mgirl_09
text: Look at that: a perfectly average-sized specimen!\nIt’s the gold standard for normality. Amazing!

label: sub_035_mgirl_10
text: This one seems a little bit smaller than average!

label: sub_035_mgirl_11
text: This one seems a good sight smaller than average!\nIt’s quite a specimen—take good care of it!

label: sub_035_mgirl_12
text: This is truly a little one! A pint-sized powerhouse\nof a [VAR 0x0101(0001)]. What a charmer!

label: sub_035_mgirl_13
text: Now THIS is a tiny Pokémon! Wow, you almost\nnever see one this little!

label: sub_035_mgirl_14
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This might just be the world’s smallest\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]!

label: sub_035_mgirl_15
text: I think this jumbo Pokémon deserves a mark for\nbeing such a monument to massiveness!

label: sub_035_mgirl_16
text: I think this mini Pokémon deserves a mark for\nbeing such a triumph of tininess!

label: sub_035_system_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0102(0001)] received a\nJumbo Mark!

label: sub_035_system_02
text: [VAR 0x0102(0001)] received a Mini Mark!

label: sub_035_mgirl_17
text: Come ask me anytime you want to know about\nyour Pokémon’s size!

label: sub_035_mgirl_18
text:
Hey! Did you know Pokémon of the same species
can come in all sorts of sizes?\c
Take my Pachirisu. It’s easy to see the difference
between ’em, right?\c
Me, I’ve got a sharp eye. I can tell the exact size
of a Pokémon just by looking at it!
